rule: Ordinary Monday-Friday settlement schedule minus the explicitly sourced annual holiday exclusions below. Do not substitute NYSE sessions or a federal-office calendar. Exception notices override annual tables; scheduled settlement is distinct from completion and broker credit.
cash_policy_proposal: Treat proceeds as unavailable throughout scheduled settlement and any documented rollover; a future replay may release only at the next regular-session open after settlement completion. This conservative convention is not evidence of actual Alpaca account credit and must be frozen with the dataset before outcomes.
